description: List the user interviews in a workspace, newest first, optionally filtered to one project. Returns summary rows; call get_interview for the discussion guide and participants, or get_interview_report for the findings.

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects. Only interviews in this project are returned; omit to list every interview in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_interviews

id.description: Interview UUID, the interview_id other interview tools take.

report_status.description: Report synthesis status, e.g. idle, queued, running, completed or failed.

status.description: Interview status: draft, ready, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

target_url.description: The URL participants are sent to.

title: List interviews
